POC plan & boundaries

1. Validate ID import and deduplication.
2. Add supplied text and inspect topic grouping.
3. Verify source-linked extractive summaries.
4. Test extension JSON export → app import.
5. Next: authenticated API, durable storage, approved acquisition, embeddings and LLM synthesis.

The extension saves only the current post URL when clicked. It does not observe LinkedIn saves or fetch private endpoints.
